meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: Claude 会把原始数据按 Setup→Conflict→Resolution 框架组织成叙事,产出结论先行的标题、关键洞察、对比图表与演示模板,面向非技术受众。
howto.when: 当你准备向高管汇报、做季度业务复盘或投资者演示时使用;也可在需要把数据结论讲给非技术受众时触发。

say.text: 把这份流失数据做成向高管汇报的故事,结论放前面
say.note: 会按叙事框架输出标题、洞察与建议

say.text: 用 Setup-Conflict-Resolution 框架写一份季度业务复盘
say.note: 套用该框架生成复盘结构

say.text: 把这份市场数据改成对比故事,并给出先进入哪个市场的建议
say.note: 输出对比表与推荐结论

howto.what_en: Claude reorganizes raw data into a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative, producing headline-first insights, comparison charts and presentation templates for non-technical audiences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you prepare an executive presentation, quarterly business review, investor deck, or otherwise need to explain data insights to non-technical listeners.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into an executive story with the conclusion up front.
Write a quarterly review using the Setup-Conflict-Resolution framework.
Turn this market data into a comparison story with a region recommendation.
